response.justification: Bogdan brings well over the required 8 years of software development experience and genuinely relevant developer-tooling depth — he authored a test runner (Trial), an assertion library (Fluent-Asserts), built and maintained GitLab/CI/deploy infrastructure, and taught test-automation courses, which maps closely to the engineering-productivity focus. However, the role is fundamentally a people-management position (Level II Manager), and the resume shows no evidence of the required 2+ years of people management or formal team leadership: all titles are individual-contributor (Senior/Staff Engineer, Founder), with no mention of direct reports, performance reviews, or headcount. Mobile-platform exposure exists but is thin and dated (iOS/Apple TV apps in 2015-16, device orchestration tooling). He is a plausible candidate for a first-time manager conversation given the strong technical and tooling fit, but does not currently meet the stated management minimum.
strengths: Deep, hands-on developer-tooling and test-infrastructure experience (Trial, Fluent-Asserts, CI/CD, GitLab admin)
15+ years of broad engineering across web, mobile, desktop, embedded — well above the 8-year minimum
Strong knowledge-sharing track record: workshops, conference talks, Selenium curriculum, open-source founder
concerns: No documented people-management experience or direct reports (2-year minimum unmet)
No evidence of roadmap ownership, performance management, or leading organizational change
Mobile-platform exposure is limited and roughly a decade old

key_factors.factor: Developer tools and testing infrastructure depth
